test_title: PYST 50: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number-letter cluster in the same way as the fourth number-letter cluster is related to the third number-letter cluster, and the second number-letter cluster is related to the first number-letter cluster.

COMPLETE : COTEMPLE :: POSITION : POONSITI :: TROPICAL : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**COMPLETE : COTEMPLE**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20bfb9833e3220b7d07426c3a9e6af63602d9513758d5437d524a4a9588d7ec8.png] 

**POSITION : POONSITI**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/494c065abb8491a8fea273023a95c605d1d2d2f5e70239675b847d8049f10cb1.png] 

Similarly,

**TROPICAL : ? **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4308c6dc2f888f16734898d1cbb9df11ba3419a1f2fca4b11bf8d201d4a1124.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"TRALOPIC".**
